PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Senior Analyst- Data Quality & Analytics | LSEG (Refinitiv) — Bengaluru | Jun 2022 – Present • Designed and implemented SQL-based frameworks (CTEs, joins, aggregations) to validate large datasets and identify anomalies, missing attributes, and inconsistencies • Developed fraud detection logic to uncover suspicious patterns including dormant activity, structured transactions (smurfing), and cross-border anomalies • Built a rule-based risk scoring model using transaction and KYC attributes to classify customers and support compliance decision-making • Performed trend and pattern analysis to identify systemic data issues, enabling process improvements and reducing recurring errors • Led QC operations including sampling strategy, risk-based case selection, quality scoring, and performance reporting • Conducted root cause analysis (RCA) and thematic reviews to identify underlying issues and recommend data and process remediation • Implemented advanced matching logic to detect duplicate entities and maintain golden record standards • Developed interactive dashboards (Power BI/Tableau) to monitor SLA performance, exception trends, and quality metrics • Migrated and optimized SQL scripts from Oracle to MS SQL Server, improving data processing efficiency and query performance • Collaborated with cross-functional teams to define validation rules, improve data governance, and align with business requirements
CORPORATE
Analyst | Refinitiv India Shared Services Pvt Ltd. Bengaluru | Oct 2018 – May 2022
Performed end-to-end Corporate KYC processes including Customer Due Diligence (CDD) and Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) • Analyzed corporate structures including IBO, UBO, subsidiaries, SPVs, JVs, and complex ownership hierarchies • Assigned and validated client risk ratings based on KYC policy, jurisdictional risk, and business activity • Performed screening and due diligence to identify regulatory and compliance risks • Maintained and validated KYC data attributes ensuring accuracy, completeness, and audit readiness • Collaborated with stakeholders to resolve data issues and improve KYC data quality and coverage Order Fulfilment Specialist | Thomson Reuters India Pvt Ltd. Bengaluru | Jan 2017 – Sep 2018 • Handled high-volume entitlement cases; performed operational analytics to support workflow
allocation and SLA management.
Prepared daily/weekly reports analysing case volumes, backlogs, and turnaround times for
management.
Trainee Content Analyst | Thomson Reuters India Pvt Ltd. Bengaluru | Sep 2015 – Dec 2016 • Analysed SEC filings (8-K, 10-K) and global disclosures to derive organizational structures and validate reference data. • Supported data pipelines feeding downstream KYC analytics and compliance functions.
GitHub Project: Global KYC & Fraud Risk Analytics • Designed and implemented a SQL-based fraud analytics solution to detect suspicious financial behaviours • Analyzed multi-dimensional datasets (customers, accounts, transactions and risk flag) to identify risk patterns and anomalies • Developed fraud detection logic including structuring, dormant account activity, and behavioural anomalies • Created a rule-based risk scoring model to classify customers & support compliance decision- making • Published project on GitHub for end-to-end analytics demonstration GitHub: https://github.com/Raj-8392/global-kyc-fraud-risk-analytics
Key Achievement: • Cleaned and reconciled large datasets (20K+ records) improving data integrity. • Delivered ~30% cycle-time reduction & ~15% productivity uplift through process analytics
and improvement initiatives.
Built 8+ dashboards to track data quality and performance metrics.
